title: Social awareness
learning_outcomes: Explain ambiguous cues in the context of social awareness.
Compare and distinguish culture and context in the context of social awareness.
Apply group norms in the context of social awareness.
Evaluate and justify decisions about clarifying questions in the context of social awareness.

lessons.title: Ambiguous cues
lessons.outcome: Explain ambiguous cues in the context of social awareness.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving ambiguous cues; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to social scenario analysis.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain ambiguous cues from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of ambiguous cues; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Culture and context
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish culture and context in the context of social awareness.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving culture and context; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to social scenario analysis.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain culture and context from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of culture and context; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Group norms
lessons.outcome: Apply group norms in the context of social awareness.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving group norms; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to social scenario analysis.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain group norms from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of group norms; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Clarifying questions
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about clarifying questions in the context of social awareness.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving clarifying questions; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to social scenario analysis.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain clarifying questions from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of clarifying questions; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of ambiguous cues; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of culture and context; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of group norms; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of clarifying questions; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
